items.computation: The letter directly states the appointment date and time for the witness hearing: Mittwoch, 13.01.2027, 09:00 Uhr, at Amtsgericht Musterquedlin, Saal 104. Appointments keep their stated date and time as written in the letter; no period calculation is needed.

warnings: This is a witness summons (Ladung als Zeuge), not a court decision, so there is no Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung and no right of appeal against it; failure to appear without sufficient excuse can lead to costs and a fine (Ordnungsgeld) under § 380 ZPO, so attendance (or a timely, well-justified excuse submitted to the court) is important.
